title: commission_payout:process never seeded — runBatch & processForRecipient always FORBIDDEN
description: runBatch and processForRecipient both require commission_payout:process. Neither seed file (seed-rbac.ts nor seeds/permissions.seed.ts) seeds that action — only read/create/update are seeded. Every call returns FORBIDDEN for all users including admins.
evidence: seed-rbac.ts:119-122 — only read/create/update. payouts.ts:187 — requirePermissionOrpc(..., 'commission_payout', 'process')

title: commission_review:resolve never seeded — resolveReview always FORBIDDEN
description: resolveReviewProcedure requires permission resource='commission_review', action='resolve'. No seed file seeds this resource/action pair. The Review tab approve/reject buttons always fail.
evidence: grep across packages/db/src — 0 results for commission_review

title: Payment view: item.date.toISOString() runtime crash — date is already a string over oRPC
description: oRPC serializes Date objects to ISO strings over JSON. The code calls item.date.toISOString() but item.date is a string at runtime. Throws TypeError: item.date.toISOString is not a function — crashes the entire payment history view on load.
evidence: date: item.date ? item.date.toISOString() : null

title: Notification dispatch: unbounded SELECT — no LIMIT on pending notifications
description: The pending notifications SELECT has no LIMIT. A large tenant with thousands of queued notifications in the 48h window will load all of them into Worker memory (128 MB cap), risking OOM or CPU timeout.
evidence: Only .limit(1) exists on the user-lookup sub-query; the pending query at line 65 has none.

title: addEmailAndDispatchMagicLink: no RBAC scope check — any staff can reassign email for out-of-scope customer
description: Fetches customerProfile by ID but never looks up the member's hierarchyScopeId against accessibleNodeIds. A trainer in Branch A can add/replace the email of a customer in Branch B, then dispatch a magic-link — potential account takeover.
evidence: No members lookup, no accessibleNodeIds check. Compare softDelete (line 220-231) which performs the check.

title: resendMagicLink: no RBAC scope check — same omission as CU-002
description: Same pattern as CU-002. customer_management:update permission check but no accessibleNodeIds validation.
evidence: Lines 593-604: profile fetched by ID, no member lookup, no scope check

title: sendClaimLink: no RBAC scope check — staff in restricted scope can send claim link for any tenant customer
description: Finds profile by ID, checks isUnclaimed, but never validates against accessibleNodeIds. Any staff with customer_management:update can send a claim link for customers in other branches.
evidence: Lines 799-815: profile fetch, isUnclaimed check — no scope validation

title: createUnclaimed is non-atomic — CP user created then tenant write fails → orphaned CP user
description: Three sequential cross-DB writes: (1) insert CP user, (2) membershipService.createMember, (3) insert tenant customerProfiles. If steps 2 or 3 fail, the CP user exists with no tenant member/profile and no compensating delete.
evidence: Lines 716, 731, 740 — sequential awaits, no surrounding try/catch or rollback

title: PayoutsTab UI gates on commission_payout:update but API requires :process — buttons show but always fail
description: canRunBatch uses hasPermission('commission_payout:update'). Backend requires 'process'. A user with 'update' sees the Run Batch / Process Pending buttons but every click returns FORBIDDEN.
evidence: payouts-tab.tsx: hasPermission('commission_payout:update'); payouts.ts:187: 'process'

title: Dashboard index: no error states on any query — silent zeros on API failure
description: All 8 useQuery calls expose no isError branch in the render. A failed query shows RM 0.00 or empty lists with no user-facing error or retry option.
evidence: kpisQuery, todayKpisQuery, staffQuery, etc. — isError never used

title: Dashboard: no role-gating — trainers see all admin KPIs and revenue data
description: No hasRole/hasPermission guard on any widget. Trainers see org-wide revenue, branch breakdowns, and all-staff performance tables. Queries 403 silently, showing zeros.
evidence: function DashboardComponent() — no permission checks on any section

title: Notification dispatch: TOCTOU race on emailSentAt — concurrent cron runs can double-send
description: No DB-level lock (SELECT FOR UPDATE). Both concurrent cron invocations can find NULL-emailSentAt, send the email, then each write emailSentAt. Cloudflare Workers crons rarely overlap but it's not impossible.
evidence: isNull(notifications.emailSentAt) ... sendEmail ... .set({ emailSentAt: sql`now()` }) — no transaction lock

title: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET falls back to public default — sessions forgeable in misconfigured deployments
description: If BETTER_AUTH_SECRET is missing, code uses the well-known string 'dev-secret-key-minimum-32-characters-long'. Any token signed with this key is trivially forgeable.
evidence: getEnvVar('BETTER_AUTH_SECRET') || 'dev-secret-key-minimum-32-characters-long'

title: CORS allowlist hardcodes localhost origins at module level — always active in production
description: ALLOWED_ORIGINS is a module-level constant including http://localhost:3021 etc., not conditional on NODE_ENV. On production Workers, a request with Origin: http://localhost:3021 gets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
evidence: const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = new Set<string>(['http://localhost:3021', ...])

title: Sidebar Payouts item: isActive never true because pathname excludes '?', and Link to with embedded query string is non-standard
description: isActive = pathname.startsWith(item.url) where item.url='/dashboard/commissions/view?tab=payouts'. pathname='/dashboard/commissions/view' never contains '?'. Item never highlighted. <Link to={item.url}> with query string in 'to' prop is also non-standard in TanStack Router.
evidence: app-sidebar.tsx:386: pathname.startsWith(item.url)

title: Payment view: Created By column shows raw user ID instead of resolved name
description: API handler resolves createdByName but view maps created_by: item.createdBy (the raw UUID), not item.createdByName. Staff see UUIDs in the Created By column.
evidence: created_by: item.createdBy — should be item.createdByName

title: payouts.list RBAC: appointment-less batch payouts bypass branch scope check
description: RBAC filter OR(isNull(appointmentId), inArray(branchId, accessibleNodeIds)). Batch payouts have no appointmentId — isNull arm always true, bypassing branch scope check.
evidence: payouts.ts:54-60 — isNull(payouts.appointmentId) unconditionally passes all appointment-less rows

title: createUnclaimed: no phone deduplication — duplicate unclaimed profiles possible
description: No lookup against customerProfiles.phone before inserting. Double-submitting Quick Add creates two orphaned placeholder users with the same phone.
evidence: No prior lookup before insert

title: 'Online' payment shows 'payment link will be generated' but no link is ever sent
description: PaymentStep subtitle says 'Send a payment link'. Router transforms 'online' → 'stripe', sets paymentStatus='pending'. No link is dispatched.
evidence: METHOD_CONFIG: { method: 'online', subtitle: 'Send a payment link' }; router transforms; no link dispatch

title: Sales view: STATUS_PILLS maps 'cancelled' value to 'Refunded' label — misleading filter
description: Clicking 'Refunded' filter queries status='cancelled'. Cancelled and refunded are distinct states.
evidence: { value: 'cancelled', label: 'Refunded', dot: 'bg-[#737373]' }

title: Sidebar Packages link uses service_management:read but route requires package_management:read
description: Permission mismatch: sidebar hides Packages unless service_management:read; route guard checks package_management:read. Users see broken nav or invisible accessible routes.
evidence: sidebar: permission: 'service_management:read'; route beforeLoad: requirePermission('package_management:read')

title: Notification email subject not sanitized — CRLF header injection risk
description: notification.title used directly as subject with no CRLF stripping. escapeHtml is applied to HTML body only.
evidence: subject: notification.title

title: Quick Add email field silently dropped — UI collects it, server schema excludes it
description: QuickAddTab passes email to createUnclaimed but server Zod schema has no email field. The value is silently stripped.
evidence: add-customer-dialog.tsx:134 passes email; server schema has no email field

title: Sales $id: line items only visible in Print Receipt modal — not in main view
description: Order Summary card shows totals/metadata only. Line items and tax breakdown require opening Print Receipt modal.
evidence: No items table rendered outside printDialogOpen context

title: Cancel Sale button gated on status='confirmed' — POS sales complete immediately, button never shows
description: POS sales land at 'completed' not 'confirmed'. Cancel button never renders for typical POS sales.
evidence: order.status === 'confirmed' && <CancelSaleButton>

title: MagicLinkActions: placeholder domain mismatch — @ghl.placeholder vs @avantej.placeholder
description: PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN = '@ghl.placeholder' on client; server uses 'avantej.placeholder'. A profile with isUnclaimed=false but @avantej.placeholder email falls into wrong UI branch.
evidence: client line 21: '@ghl.placeholder'; server line 29: 'avantej.placeholder'
